note: Memory acceptance rules. Enforced at extraction time; the retrieval guard is a fallback for repositories not yet reindexed.

R1-path-derivable.test: Mask the file path out of the content. If the remainder is a constant string shared by every memory of that type, the memory carries no per-file information.
R1-path-derivable.rationale: The structural role of a path is already stored in routes/entities; restating it consumes a retrieval slot for nothing.

R2-model-redundant.test: A structured table already holds the same (subject, source) tuple at equal or greater precision.
R2-model-redundant.rationale: Index the structured row for FTS/vector instead of duplicating it as a memory row.

R3-saturated-signal.test: A pattern-derived memory whose signal fires on more than 50% of eligible files.
R3-saturated-signal.rationale: A property shared by most files is a baseline, not an observation.

R4-occurrence-not-fact.test: Two memories differ only by evidence location.
R4-occurrence-not-fact.rationale: One fact with N occurrences. Deleting loses the occurrence; normalizing keeps it. Implemented by RCE-005.

R5-quotable-evidence.test: The claim cannot be verified against a specific line range in its own evidence file.
R5-quotable-evidence.rationale: Already enforced for AI-produced memories; extended to deterministic ones.

business_capability.detail: All nine records are byte-identical apart from the file path.

performance_observation.detail: src/analyzers/source-facts.ts matches /^(next\/dynamic|react)$/; every plain React import becomes a performance signal. Narrow the pattern to next/dynamic and the memo/callback family; keep the useCallback record.

dependency.detail: Exactly 1:1 with the dependencies table (31 = 31). Index the structured row instead.

build.detail: Reject only 'next.config.ts configures the Next.js build/runtime'. Dockerfile and tsconfig records name concrete base images and settings; keep them.

configuration.detail: Environment declarations become entity occurrences, not memories.

rendering.detail: Route facts; evidence breadth is fixed by RCE-005, not by rejection.

seo.detail: static vs generateMetadata requires reading the file.

api_dependency.detail: Fetch targets; constant resolution is RCE-010's job.

cache_invalidation.detail: Exact tag/path invalidation calls and their owning symbol are behavior, not path-derived metadata.

server_function.detail: File- or function-scoped use server directives identify callable server boundaries and their observed effects.

authorization.detail: Specific authorization calls, role/permission checks, and forbidden/unauthorized outcomes are line-located enforcement facts.

schema_contract.detail: Validation schemas and observed form/JSON payload keys expose domain contracts with focused evidence.

analytics_event.detail: Static event names, transports, and payload keys are more precise than generic analytics-presence memories.

next_config.detail: Concrete settings and rewrite/redirect/header rules replace the rejected path-only next.config statement.

special_file.detail: The exact Next.js convention and route scope affect runtime behavior; instrumentation files are intentionally excluded from this phase.

repository_dependency.detail: Cross-repository package links live in the relational graph and repository MCP response instead of duplicating package.json rows as vectors.

error_handling.detail: HTTP failure responses and their enclosing guard/catch condition are source-verifiable behavior.

module_contract.detail: Nullable returns and registry/config entries are focused, line-located contracts not represented by the dependency graph.
